reason: A web UI plugin that integrates with the DeepSeek balance API and displays account balance details with configurable refresh and presentation settings.

summaries.zh: 通过配置的 DeepSeek API 密钥查询账户余额，并在 Web 界面侧边栏和设置页显示余额详情。
summaries.en: Queries the DeepSeek account balance API with a configured API key and displays balance details in the web UI sidebar and settings page.

capabilities: Queries the DeepSeek user balance API using a configured API key
Displays balance, currency, grant, and top-up information in the web UI
Provides manual and optional automatic balance refresh
Adds balance-related settings and a sidebar widget
